# Speechify

> Speechify is an AI-powered accessibility platform offering text-to-speech, voice typing, and voice AI tools trusted by 50M+ users to read, write, and interact with content faster.

Founded by Cliff Weitzman to address dyslexia and accessibility needs, Speechify provides free and premium tools across web, mobile, and desktop platforms. The platform features advanced AI voices, video dubbing, podcast creation, and voice AI assistance powered by Speechify Studio.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-Speech
- Voice Typing & Dictation

## Core Products

- [Speechify: Free Text to Speech Reader](https://speechify.com): Speechify homepage: text-to-speech reader for books, PDFs, web pages
- [Free Text-to-Speech Online](https://speechify.com/text-to-speech-online): Free online text-to-speech tool for PDFs, books, docs with AI voices
- [Free Voice Typing & Dictation](https://speechify.com/voice-typing-dictation): Voice typing and dictation for emails, docs, messages with 50M+ users
- [Voice AI Assistant](https://speechify.com/voice-ai): Voice AI Assistant for hands-free writing, research, and web interaction

## Platform Apps & Extensions

- [Text to Speech iOS App](https://speechify.com/text-to-speech-ios): Speechify iOS app for text-to-speech with dyslexia support
- [Text to Speech Android App](https://speechify.com/text-to-speech-android): Speechify Android app with 1M+ downloads and natural AI voices
- [Mac App](https://speechify.com/text-to-speech-mac): Mac app with voice AI, voice typing, and text-to-speech for macOS
- [Chrome Extension](https://speechify.com/text-to-speech-chrome-extension): Chrome extension for text-to-speech and voice typing with 1M+ downloads
- [Microsoft Edge Extension](https://speechify.com/edge-text-to-speech-extension): Microsoft Edge extension for text-to-speech with 1M+ downloads
- [Web App](https://speechify.com/text-to-speech-web): Web-based text-to-speech with natural AI voices and 1M+ downloads
- [Download Hub](https://speechify.com/download): Download hub for Speechify apps across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, Edge

## Speechify Studio

- [AI Voice Generator](https://speechify.com/ai-voice-generator): AI voice generator with 1000+ voices in 60+ languages via Speechify Studio
- [Voice Cloning](https://speechify.com/voice-cloning): Voice cloning tool for realistic audio creation via Speechify Studio
- [AI Dubbing](https://speechify.com/dubbing): AI dubbing tool for multi-language video localization via Speechify Studio
- [Studio Voices](https://speechify.com/studio-voices): Studio Voices feature with emotion tags and voice actions for narration
- [AI Captions Generator](https://speechify.com/studio-captions): AI captions generator for automatic video subtitles and transcription
- [AI Podcast Creation](https://speechify.com/podcasts): AI podcast creation tool for converting documents to podcasts
